confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Rio's visitor-area prices; no live listings or city-price searches were used. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately grounded. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor because direct price knowledge for them is weaker. Accommodation is least certain: July is not off-season (school holidays and winter demand), and nightly rates vary with season, events and currency. Accommodation figures assume taxes and mandatory fees are included. The FX figure (15 Oct 2026) comes from search results attributing it to the RBA exchange-rates overview page, which I did not open directly. An unconfirmed 16 Oct figure from third-party sites was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Brazil's large coastal tourism metros, with the visitor area taken as Rio's Zona Sul (Copacabana, Ipanema, Leblon, Botafogo, Flamengo). No specific comparable city was used; anchors rely on general knowledge of local price levels.
